title: Two reminders set in one message; cancel one by its subject; the other must still fire

turns.prompt: Set two reminders for me: in 3 minutes append 'WATER PLANTS' to {D}/remind.log, and in 4 minutes append 'CALL BANK' to {D}/remind.log. Confirm both with their times.
Scrap the plants one — the bank one stays.
turns.verify: f={D}/remind.log; p=0; b=0; if [ -f $f ]; then p=$(grep -c 'WATER PLANTS' $f); b=$(grep -c 'CALL BANK' $f); fi; echo "SHOW plants=$p bank=$b"; if [ "$p" -eq 0 ] && [ "$b" -ge 1 ]; then echo PASS; else echo FAIL: plants=$p bank=$b; fi

regression: #2146 (reminders written to the previous task's folder; the explicit path must win)
